report.summary: Consolidated 5 confirmed findings from v-embeddings and 8 from v-picker into 11 ranked action items covering silent correctness errors, missing implementations, and inefficiencies. 3 undecidable claims deferred to risk list pending missing source.
risks: UNDECIDABLE: Work_queue disabled by default? Inspect build_queue logic.
UNDECIDABLE: TOCTOU on queue file read from load_work_queue; inspect body.
UNDECIDABLE: Claims 16,17,20 require full source of build_queue/load_work_queue to verify.
todos: Fix NaN propagation in _candidate (v-picker claim 9): Add math.isfinite(offset) check.
Refactor _embed_batch to raise on EmbeddingError instead of returning None (v-embeddings: error swallowing).
Add WAL mode and busy timeout to _init_db to prevent SQLITE_BUSY (v-embeddings: concurrency).
Enforce evidence schema in _candidate beyond non-empty check (v-picker claim 7).
Allow zero vectors in _normalize_vector when normalization='none' (v-embeddings: potential correctness).
Implement search_report, ingest_report, record_journal_watermark or remove docstring promises (v-embeddings: missing implementations).
Add starvation detector alert for low-band candidates pending too long (v-picker claim 1).
Implement band escalation when offset reaches BAND_SPAN (v-picker claim 2), and add cross-band ordering test.
Review OUTCOME_POLICY to avoid penalizing high-importance candidates on retry (v-picker claim 5).
Fix silent config masking in _project_config: raise or warn on non-Mapping input (v-picker claim 8).
Make eval/hotspot sources cheap by default or warn when disabled (v-picker claim 3).

handoff.suggestion: Apply changes in picker.py and embeddings.py. picker.py: add offset validation, evidence schema, band escalation, starvation detector, OUTCOME_POLICY review, config masking fix, cheap sources adjustment. embeddings.py: enable WAL/busy timeout in _init_db, refactor _embed_batch error handling, implement missing methods, fix _normalize_vector for 'none' normalization.
